description: MPP cleavage-motif check at the annotated Mis1 34/35 boundary, helical-wheel view of the amphipathic segment, and export of the evidence matrix and GO decision table to provenance
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, os, requests

MIS1 = requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P09440.fasta",timeout=60).text
MIS1 = "".join(MIS1.split("\n")[1:])
pre, mature = MIS1[:34], MIS1[34:]
print("Mis1 presequence 1-34 :", pre)
print("Mature N-terminus 35- :", mature[:20], "...")

print("\n### MPP cleavage-motif check at the annotated 34/35 boundary")
for off,label in [(2,"R-2"),(3,"R-3"),(10,"R-10")]:
    pos = 35-off
    print(f"  {label}: residue {pos} = {MIS1[pos-1]}  -> {'Arg present' if MIS1[pos-1]=='R' else 'not Arg'}")
print("  Arg positions in 1-34:", [i+1 for i,c in enumerate(pre) if c=="R"])
print("  Acidic positions in 1-34:", [i+1 for i,c in enumerate(pre) if c in "DE"] or "none")
print("  Note: no canonical R-2/R-3/R-10 arginine at this boundary. The 1-34 end point in UniProt")
print("  is tied to PubMed:3528153 (mature-protein N-terminal sequencing), not to a motif rule.")

# helical wheel of the top-scoring amphipathic window (residues 7-24)
EIS=dict(A=0.62,R=-2.53,N=-0.78,D=-0.90,C=0.29,Q=-0.85,E=-0.74,G=0.48,H=-0.40,I=1.38,
         L=1.06,K=-1.50,M=0.64,F=1.19,P=0.12,S=-0.18,T=-0.05,W=0.81,Y=0.26,V=1.08)
win=MIS1[6:24]; start=7
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,5.4))
for ax,(seq,s0,title) in zip(axes,[(win,start,"Mis1 7-24 (max hydrophobic moment)"),
                                   ("MAGQVLDGKACAQQFRSN",1,"Ade3 1-18 (same length)")]):
    ang=np.deg2rad(100*np.arange(len(seq)))
    x,y=np.sin(ang),np.cos(ang)
    h=np.array([EIS.get(c,0.) for c in seq])
    mx,my=(h*np.sin(ang)).sum()/len(seq),(h*np.cos(ang)).sum()/len(seq)
    ax.plot(x,y,color="#cbd2d9",lw=1,zorder=1)
    for i,(xi,yi,c) in enumerate(zip(x,y,seq)):
        col = "#d1495b" if c in "RK" else ("#3a7ca5" if c in "DE" else ("#f0a202" if EIS.get(c,0)>0.5 else "#9aa5b1"))
        ax.scatter(xi,yi,s=620,color=col,edgecolor="k",zorder=2)
        ax.text(xi,yi,f"{c}{s0+i}",ha="center",va="center",fontsize=8,color="w",fontweight="bold",zorder=3)
    ax.arrow(0,0,mx*4,my*4,width=0.025,color="k",length_includes_head=True,zorder=4)
    ax.set_title(f"{title}\nmuH = {np.hypot(mx,my):.3f}",fontsize=10)
    ax.set_xlim(-1.5,1.5); ax.set_ylim(-1.5,1.5); ax.set_aspect("equal"); ax.axis("off")
fig.suptitle("Helical wheels: red = Arg/Lys, blue = Asp/Glu, orange = hydrophobic. Arrow = hydrophobic moment vector",
             fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

out="/agent/jobs/1373acf3-bd7b-4d11-aee0-2f9a139d8765/provenance"
os.makedirs(out,exist_ok=True)

evidence = pd.DataFrame([

      stance="supports", claim_tested="Mis1 protein resides in mitochondria, Ade3 does not",
      key_finding="Isozyme purified from an ade3 deletion strain fractionates with mitochondria; Ade3 enzyme does not",

      stance="supports", claim_tested="MIS1 ORF encodes an N-terminal extension cleaved from the mature protein",

      context="S. cerevisiae genomic clone", confidence="high for sequence, moderate for exact cleavage position"),

      stance="supports", claim_tested="Mis1 1-34 is paralog-specific",
      key_finding="72.0% identity over 938 aligned columns; 32-residue Ade3 gap opposite Mis1 5-36",
      context="in silico", confidence="high; alignment is unambiguous at the N-terminus"),

      stance="supports", claim_tested="Mis1 1-34 has presequence physicochemistry; Ade3 does not",
      key_finding="Mis1 net charge +6, zero acidic, muH 0.415, classifier p=0.955 (CV AUC 0.949); Ade3 p=0.087",
      context="in silico, yeast proteome-wide reference sets", confidence="high; feature-based, not a published predictor"),

      key_finding="mean pLDDT 32.6 for residues 1-34 vs 93.8 for 35-975",
      context="in silico", confidence="moderate; low pLDDT indicates disorder, not targeting per se"),

      stance="supports", claim_tested="Mis1 supplies 10-formyl-THF inside mitochondria",
      key_finding="mis1 disruption abolishes in vivo formylation of mitochondrial initiator Met-tRNA",
      context="S. cerevisiae, mitochondrial tRNA analysis", confidence="high for matrix function; indirect for localization"),

      context="S. cerevisiae gene-disruption combinations", confidence="high; means a mis1 phenotype can be cytosolic without cytosolic Mis1"),

      stance="competing", claim_tested="Mis1 is also cytosolic",

      context="database inference across the C1-THF synthase family", confidence="low; classic paralog-driven over-propagation"),

      stance="supports (resource)", claim_tested="Mature N-termini of yeast mitochondrial proteins",
      key_finding="615 mitochondrial protein N-termini mapped; more cleavable presequences than predicted; Icp55 trims MPP products",
      context="isolated yeast mitochondria, MS", confidence="high as a dataset; Mis1 entry not verified here"),
])
evidence.to_csv(f"{out}/MIS1_evidence_matrix.csv",index=False)

go = pd.DataFrame([

      recommended_action="retain", rationale="Direct fractionation of the purified isozyme; corroborated by presequence analysis"),

      recommended_action="consider adding as a lead (ISS/IC)", rationale="Cleavable presequence plus soluble trifunctional enzyme supplying matrix 10-formyl-THF for fMet-tRNA formylation (PMID 10781559); needs submitochondrial data to confirm"),

      recommended_action="remove or mark non-core", rationale="No yeast experimental support; PMID 3528153 explicitly separates Mis1 from the cytosolic activity; likely Ade3 paralog propagation"),

      recommended_action="retain", rationale="Measured on the purified mitochondrial isozyme (PMID 3528153)"),

      recommended_action="retain", rationale="Measured on the purified mitochondrial isozyme"),
 dict(go_id="GO:0004488", aspect="MF", term="methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity", current_evidence="IDA (SGD)",
      recommended_action="retain", rationale="Measured on the purified mitochondrial isozyme"),
 dict(go_id="GO:0035999", aspect="BP", term="tetrahydrofolate interconversion", current_evidence="IBA",
      recommended_action="retain, upgrade evidence", rationale="Directly supported by the three measured activities; could be IDA-backed"),
 dict(go_id="GO:0046656", aspect="BP", term="folic acid biosynthetic process", current_evidence="IDA (SGD)",
      recommended_action="query / likely generalize or replace", rationale="Mis1 interconverts one-carbon THF derivatives, it does not synthesise the folate ring; GO:0035999 or one-carbon metabolic process fits better"),
 dict(go_id="GO:0006450 / GO:0070184-type", aspect="BP", term="regulation of translational fidelity / mitochondrial translation support", current_evidence="not annotated",
      recommended_action="do not add", rationale="PMID 10781559 shows fMet-tRNA formylation is dispensable for mitochondrial translation; this is a downstream pathway consequence, not Mis1 core function"),
])
go.to_csv(f"{out}/MIS1_GO_decision_table.csv",index=False)
print("\nSaved:", os.listdir(out))
print("\n### GO decision table")
print(go[["go_id","aspect","term","current_evidence","recommended_action"]].to_string(index=False))
